shell.supplied: Original iPad/iPhone root tabs, exact scene identity, native Library/Search/Annotations/History/Settings parents and original sidebar owners are present.
shell.gaps: Authors, book-info, exact sidebar visibility/palette/menu/popover states have no dedicated finite binding. Library/TOC parent selection covers those pages only. Notes root candidate still needs actual rerun.

bootstrap.supplied: Original backend consent, corpus installation/import and welcome/update UI remain authoritative.
bootstrap.gaps: These are consent/readiness flows, not implicit GET installs or backend switches. Exercise their real unavailable/consent/failure states; do not invent navigation success for absent assets.

library.supplied: Original LibraryViewModel, iOSLibraryView and UIKit controller remain owners. Four new finite anchors reveal contents, grouping, downloaded filter and options without executing them.
library.gaps: Exact category expansion/selected work/book-info/author/narrator and import/update review targets remain unbound. Reader.open covers opening canonical content, not selecting a Library row. Existing user actions still require original functional acceptance.

reader.supplied: Original Reader/Core opens backend-qualified section/focus locators in the existing or a new tab; retained Reader identity and actual native content receipt are implemented. Original TextKit/selection/options/book-search UI is retained.
reader.gaps: Independent text-range selection and exact navigation-slider/book-info/view-options/in-book-search target bindings are not established. A focusLocator is not a proof of arbitrary UIKit selection or complete viewport restoration.

toc.supplied: Original iOSTOCView owns list, structure selector, search/expansion and ScrollViewReader. Finite contents/structure/currentSelection anchors retain exact node/ancestor/source identities and actual layout/witness. Original phone workspace path and iPad matching fix supplied.
toc.gaps: Arbitrary public node/structure-value/query/expansion state is not supplied by the three reveal anchors. Native current-row scrolling, structure-picker and downloaded-filter focused cases remain unexecuted or without a new selector.

inspector.supplied: Original TorahInspectorKit and native iPad trailing system sheet remain. reader.openCommentary resolves an actual source relationship and opens canonical commentary in a new Reader tab, preserving base. Root inspector route opens actual tools.
inspector.gaps: No finite exact tool/tab/commentary-group/note-item selector is installed. Core opening commentary content does not prove that an exact row/group is selected inside Inspector. Actual detents/source navigation/notes/resize/VO remain final acceptance.

notes.supplied: notes.prepareDraft and optional Reader/commentary intent proposal use original unsaved editor and original approval/Save/Cancel actions.
notes.gaps: No finite body/tags/style/editor-control focus binding. Save/delete remain explicit user actions, never GET. Standalone note selection/editor identity and original save/edit/delete/cancel need acceptance; source draft controls are not persistence proof.

annotations.supplied: Original global annotations screen and native.annotations root route retained; duplicate root mode publication removed in candidate.
annotations.gaps: Historical D root route actually failed; current candidate has not run. Filter/import/export/book-specific/conflict-review selections have no finite state binding. No claim that a displayed navigation title proves notes content mounted.

search.supplied: Original global/in-book search and original CommandPalette are retained. Native query-field focus exists only when its exact field is already visible. Trusted search.openResults uses original engine and native receipt for supported subset.
search.gaps: Cold/warm parent-then-query-focus is missing and is the next assigned implementation. Native results accepts phrase/exact/distance0 only, default first page, Otzaria-only nonempty work scope; no selectedHit/cursor target. No independent ShowSearchResults AppIntent wrapper. Existing 54 native control rows are user controls/states, not automatically authorized public mutations.

bookmarks.supplied: Original saved-results/bookmark/folder UI and user actions exist; legacy History links are preserved separately.
bookmarks.gaps: No native bookmarks/Saved Results parent or stable exact folder/record selection binding. History root does not cover Saved Results. Rename/move/delete/save require original user confirmation rather than URL writes.

history.supplied: Original History/Favorites parent and strict native receipt, legacy widget handler, system AppIntent and new actual Siri selectors are supplied.
history.gaps: Exact history/favorite-picker/item selection is not supplied by root navigation. New Siri selectors are prepared but not executed; remembered legacy URL content does not prove arbitrary History-row binding.

workspace.supplied: Original StudyWorkspaceStore/NavigationAdapter, profiles, groups, DuckDuckGo strip, original overview Grid/List and restoration already exist. Two actual parent presentations and nine fixed component anchors were added using original setters and retained source.
workspace.gaps: Fixed reveal anchors do not select an arbitrary profile/group/tab or set layout preference. Exact identity/state routes remain missing. Original 3x3/30-tabs, same-book independent locators, mutations, migration, rollback, 100-switch/production restore, multiwindow/rotation and unsaved draft acceptance remain required.

settings.supplied: Original SettingsView is retained. Fifteen finite original section/control anchors and parent-then-reveal/focus use exact retained owner, Observation/backend invalidation, real layout and independent visible witness.
settings.gaps: Reveal is not value mutation or successful import/install. Dedicated language/accessibility/data-profile Settings pages were historical NOT_IMPLEMENTED placeholders; parent scopes these 'where existing', so this audit does not invent three new pages. Actual HE/EN/accessibility and production data remain required.

packages.supplied: Original offline package management remains; Core packages.list/status/checkUpdates are implemented.
packages.gaps: Core install/remove/update/cancel actions are catalog-only, not implemented. They cannot be silently exposed by GET. Preserve explicit original confirmation UI and real package failure/cancellation/asset-readiness acceptance.

ingress.supplied: Original Widget history/annotation routing and Widget configuration intents retained alongside versioned navigation ingress.
ingress.gaps: Widget configuration is not an arbitrary navigation AppIntent. Legacy actual regressions still required on the final candidate; no duplicate Expo handling.

future.supplied: All six former infrastructure placeholders now have real source: registry, orchestrator, AppIntents, Universal Link configuration, guided navigation and thin original Hanlin host.
future.gaps: Historical NOT_IMPLEMENTED labels are preserved as history, not current source conclusions. Actual system delivery/provider/guide/multiscene acceptance remains separate.

inactive.supplied: Six historical alternative SwiftUI hosts remain in source. No named live construction of their root hosts was found; nested references are under the alternative hierarchy.
inactive.gaps: Do not implement a parallel UI or count these as runtime passes. They are historical alternatives, distinct from active Exact9401/original hosts; visual/behavior requirements are satisfied only through actual active originals.

embedded.supplied: Original Sefaria JS/Expo/Hermes data integration remains, distinct from native Reader. Pinned original RN ReaderApp bridge source exists.
embedded.gaps: No Source construction of SefariaEmbeddedNativeSurfaceHost was found. Headless RPC/data readiness is not an actual visible RN surface receipt. Parent explicitly includes native RN coverage; absence cannot be waived as unsupported merely because unmounted.

embedded_rn.supplied: Forty-five semantic original RN source rows are preserved at immutable Sefaria-Mobile pin. They belong only to Embedded, not native Otzaria/Legacy variants.
embedded_rn.gaps: Actual native RN host mounting/exact state/scene+epoch acknowledgement is not established. Meaningful reading/TOC/search/library states remain an implementation gap under parent scope. Auth/account/destructive/debug preferences are not automatic public GET actions; retain their explicit original policy and conditional in-app behavior.

excluded.supplied: Four explicitly decorative presentation rows: toolbar artwork, theme material, library row layout and reader display label.
excluded.gaps: No standalone navigation action is appropriate. Their visual fidelity, localized labels and accessibility semantics remain part of original feature acceptance; this is not a waiver of those checks.

native-routing.supplied: Current native root/canonical Reader/system-ingress definitions are installed over original Core and native owner/witness contracts.
native-routing.gaps: Descriptor presence and entity discovery are conditional source capabilities, not authorization or executed acceptance for all backend/entry/lifecycle combinations.

requirements: One original @MainActor Core/registry/orchestrator chain from parse/permission/readiness/exact scene/workspace/content through specific control state to actual native View ACK.

Exact Library/category/work, Reader address/focus, Inspector source, global-search query/filter/mode/selected hit, Settings control, Notes draft, bookmark/history selection, tab/profile/group/sidebar/menu/presentation state.
Cold/warm/background/premount/multiwindow, backend generation/epoch, cancelled/deadline/replay/readiness; a queued or requested surface is never completed.
Meaningful typed AppIntent/AppEntity wrappers over original Core; stable backend-qualified entities, dependencies, foreground execution, ambiguity and honest availability.
Open book/location, optional commentary and unsaved proposal, search results state, Settings section/control, Reader/TOC and notes/bookmark/history targets as actually supported.
Actual system Shortcuts/Siri and process/lifecycle/error/native receipt acceptance; WidgetConfigurationIntent does not satisfy action delivery.
Versioned allowlisted private custom URLs and authorized HTTPS/AASA/app entitlement; exact original target state where supported.
Retain original Widget history/annotation and Expo URL/activity lifecycle; no duplicated navigation.
No private note/query payload in shareable URL, code/selector/path injection or GET writes; malformed/version/size/encoding/replay/multiwindow/offline scenarios and actual OS delivery.
Reuse the single original Hanlin SDK/Chat/Composer/tools/store through a thin scoped host; no parallel engine or untrusted authority.
Same catalog/Core/UI path for AI/MCP/guides with live source/context/cancel/consent and actual native witnesses.
At least three multistep guides with named targets, bounded readiness/cancellation/resume/replay and meaningful HE/EN/VO/RTL/Dynamic Type.
All 51 original semantic/lifecycle/security/ingress/observability families, three distinct backends, actual state and receipt evidence; maintain PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN truthfully.
Original Native116 baseline82/34 and Release114+2 remain original final-candidate gates; focused source tests are not substitutes.
Production v40/indices/Anytype/Hanlin Live/MiniApps, original regressions, iPad+iPhone, actual physical owner QA. Owner minimum is iOS/iPadOS27 only; historical26 row retained as superseded.
